verdict.rationale: The IRS's own pages document that a founder can complete the core transactions online. The EIN can be obtained through the online assistant, taxes can be paid via Direct Pay and EFTPS, and information returns can be e-filed through IRIS. Signed forms such as Form 15620 (the 83(b) election) can also be completed online through the mobile-friendly forms rail, which requires an IRS Online Account. The online EIN rail has published constraints: limited operating hours, a 15-minute no-save session, one EIN per responsible party per day, and ID.me identity proofing for signed forms. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of completing these flows, round-the-clock availability without operating-window and session limits.
